title_en: Course Registration for the Fall Semester (2nd Semester) of the 2026 Academic Year (Including Notice of the Adjusted 'Out-of-Quota Request Period' for Undergraduate Courses of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering)
summary: This notice announces course registration for the Fall Semester of the 2026 academic year and reminds students that the out-of-quota request period (formerly 'Choanji') for undergraduate courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering runs on an adjusted schedule. The registration schedule and detailed instructions are given in the attachments and linked page, which were not read.
applies_to: Students registering for courses in the Fall Semester of the 2026 academic year. The adjusted out-of-quota request (formerly 'Choanji') schedule applies only to undergraduate courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기·정보공학부); for graduate courses offered by the department, the out-of-quota request period is the same as the university schedule.

translation:
Course Registration for the Fall Semester (2nd Semester) of the 2026 Academic Year (Including Notice of the Adjusted 'Out-of-Quota Request Period' for Undergraduate Courses of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering)

Posted: 2026-07-27

Course registration for the Fall Semester (2nd semester) of the 2026 academic year is announced as follows. Please read the information carefully and register within the designated period.

Since the Fall Semester (2nd semester) of the 2023 academic year, the schedule for out-of-quota requests (정원 외 신청, formerly 초안지 'Choanji') has been adjusted, applying only to undergraduate courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기·정보공학부). Please be sure to check the adjusted schedule so that you are not disadvantaged.

(For graduate courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, the out-of-quota request period is the same as the university schedule.)

1. Course registration schedule and eligibility
[Note from the translator: the schedule and eligibility details are not included in the notice text. They may have been provided as an image or in an attachment, which was not read. Please refer to the original notice.]
※ Procedure for out-of-quota requests (초안지) for courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering in the Fall Semester of the 2026 academic year:
Link: https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=57915

2. Detailed information on using the course registration website and on course registration: please read the attached files carefully, and in particular you must read attachment [붙임1-1].
※ Additional information on misconduct in course registration
If any similar misconduct related to course registration occurs, the Department will not only cancel the course but will also convene a disciplinary committee and impose disciplinary action.
(*Misconduct in course registration includes registering using a macro, stealing or borrowing the ID of a student on leave of absence or a prospective graduate, and trading courses.)

3. Inquiries
- Course registration and changes (out-of-quota requests, course withdrawal, course overlap requests [중복수강요청]): the department office
- [Undergraduate] Changes to course classification (교과과정구분), credit recognition (including online courses), graduation requirements: the department office
- [Graduate] Credit recognition, graduation requirements: the department office
- [Scholarships] Inquiries: the undergraduate office (학부사무실)
The names and contact details for each topic are in the original notice.

Attachments:
Attachment 1-1. Guide to Course Registration for the Fall Semester of the 2026 Academic Year
Attachment 1-2. Seoul National University Course Registration Manual
Attachment 1-3. Card news on the improved course registration system to prevent course reselling
Attachment 2. Notice on misconduct in course registration
Attachment 3. Course overlap request manual

Attached files (5):
[붙임1-1] 2026학년도 2학기 수강신청 안내(Guideline for 2026 Fall Semester Course Registration)_안내용.pdf (2 MB)
[붙임1-2] 서울대학교 수강신청 매뉴얼(SNU Course Registration Manual).pdf (25 MB)
[붙임1-3] 강의매매방지 수강신청제도 개선 카드뉴스(New CRS Program for Preventing Reselling).pdf (8 MB)
[붙임2] 수강신청 부정행위 관련 알림 (Notice on Misconduct in Course Registration).pdf (40 KB)
[붙임3] 중복수강신청 매뉴얼(Course Overlap Request Manual).pdf (3 MB)

[Note from the translator: the contents of these attachments were not read and are not reflected in this translation.]
